node.title: Re: How to turn "HASH(0x1234567)" into a real HASH
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
While debugging some code that's printing "HASH(0x9999999)" to stdout

[ikegami] and [LanX] have given you some excellent answers. I am wondering why you don't just change the code you're debugging to use [doc://Data::Dumper] or [mod://Data::Dump] to show you the hashes? Even if you don't have full control over the code, Perl provides lots of ways to monkey-patch stuff in. If you could show some of the code that is generating this debug output, perhaps we could suggest a way to do that.
